title.zh: 卷11 列傳第3 晉蕩公護 叱羅協 馮遷
title.en: Volume 11 Biographies 3: Duke Hu of Jindang; Chi Luoxie; Feng Qian
title.raw: 卷11 列傳第3 晉蕩公護 叱羅協 馮遷 Volume 11 Biographies 3: Duke Hu of Jindang; Chi Luoxie; Feng Qian

sentences.zh: 晉蕩公護 叱羅協 馮遷

translations.literal: Duke Hu of Jin Hu; Chi Luoxie; Feng Qian
translations.idiomatic: Duke Hu of Jin Yuwen Hu; Chi Luoxie; Feng Qian

sentences.zh: 及出臨夏州，留護事賀拔岳。

translations.literal: When he went out to govern Xia Province, he left Hu to serve Heba Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai went out to govern Xia Province, he left Yuwen Hu to serve Heba Yue.

sentences.zh: 岳之被害，太祖至平涼，以護為都督。

translations.literal: When Yue was murdered, the Grand Progenitor reached Pingliang and made Hu commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Heba Yue was murdered, Yuwen Tai reached Pingliang and made Yuwen Hu commander.

sentences.zh: 從征侯莫陳悅，破之。

translations.literal: He followed in the campaign against Houmochen Yue and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in the campaign against Houmochen Yue and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 後以迎魏帝功，封水池縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Later, for merit in welcoming the Wei emperor, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shuichi county, fief five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Later, for merit in welcoming the Wei emperor, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shuichi county, with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 大統初，加通直散騎常侍、征虜將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, he was given directly-attendant scattered-cavalry regular attendant and general who campaigns against barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Datong (535), he was given directly-attendant scattered-cavalry regular attendant and general who campaigns against barbarians.

sentences.zh: 以預定樂勳，進爵為公，增邑通前一千戶。

translations.literal: For participating in settling the Yue merit roster, he was advanced to duke; his fief was increased with the previous total to one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: For participating in settling the Yue merit roster, he was advanced to duke; his fief was increased with the previous total to one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 從太祖擒竇泰，復弘農，破沙苑，戰河橋，並有功。

translations.literal: He followed the Grand Progenitor in capturing Dou Tai, recovering Hongnong, defeating at Shawei, and fighting at Heqiao—all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai in capturing Dou Tai, recovering Hongnong, defeating at Shawei, and fighting at Heqiao—all with merit.

sentences.zh: 遷鎮東將軍、大都督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to general who pacifies the east and grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to general who pacifies the east and grand commander.

sentences.zh: 八年，進車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was advanced to grand general of chariots and cavalry and commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (540), he was advanced to grand general of chariots and cavalry and commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol.

sentences.zh: 邙山之役，護率衆先鋒，為敵人所圍，都督侯伏侯龍恩挺身扞禦，方得免。

translations.literal: In the battle of Mount Mang, Hu led the vanguard force, was surrounded by the enemy; Commander Houfu Hou Longen personally stepped forward to resist and defend, and only then did he escape.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle of Mount Mang, Yuwen Hu led the vanguard force, was surrounded by the enemy; Commander Houfu Hou Longen personally stepped forward to resist and defend, and only then did he escape.

sentences.zh: 是時，趙貴等軍亦退，太祖遂班師。

translations.literal: At this time Zhao Gui and the others' armies also retreated, and the Grand Progenitor thereupon withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zhao Gui and the others' armies also retreated, and Yuwen Tai thereupon withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 護坐免官，尋復本位。

translations.literal: Hu was relieved of office for the fault; soon he was restored to his original position.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu was relieved of office for the fault; soon he was restored to his original position.

sentences.zh: 十二年，加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，進封中山公，增邑四百戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was given flying-cavalry grand general and commissioner with full Three Excellencies protocol; he was advanced to Duke of Zhongshan and his fief was increased by four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (544), he was given flying-cavalry grand general and commissioner with full Three Excellencies protocol; he was advanced to Duke of Zhongshan and his fief was increased by four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十五年，出鎮河東，遷大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was sent out to command Hedong and was transferred to grand general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (547), he was sent out to command Hedong and was transferred to grand general.

sentences.zh: 與于謹征江陵，護率輕騎為先鋒，晝夜兼行，乃遣裨將攻梁臨邊城鎮，並拔之。

translations.literal: With Yu Jin he campaigned against Jiangling; Hu led light cavalry as vanguard, traveling day and night without rest, then sent subordinate generals to attack Liang border fortress towns and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: With Yu Jin he campaigned against Jiangling; Yuwen Hu led light cavalry as vanguard, traveling day and night without rest, then sent subordinate generals to attack Liang border fortress towns and captured them all.

sentences.zh: 並擒其候騎，進兵徑至江陵城下。

translations.literal: He also captured their scout cavalry and advanced directly to beneath the walls of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: He also captured their scout cavalry and advanced directly to beneath the walls of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 城中不意兵至，惶窘失圖。

translations.literal: The city did not expect troops to arrive; panic and distress left them without a plan.
translations.idiomatic: The city did not expect troops to arrive; panic and distress left them without a plan.

sentences.zh: 護又遣騎二千斷江津，收舟艦以待。

translations.literal: Hu also sent two thousand cavalry to cut the Yangtze crossing and gather boats and ships to await.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu also sent two thousand cavalry to cut the Yangtze crossing and gather boats and ships to await.

sentences.zh: 大軍之至，圍而克之。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, they besieged and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: When the great army arrived, they besieged and captured it.

sentences.zh: 以功封子會為江陵公。

translations.literal: For merit his son Hui was enfeoffed as Duke of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: For merit his son Yuwen Hui was enfeoffed as Duke of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 初，襄陽蠻帥向天保等萬有餘落，恃險作梗。

translations.literal: Initially the Xiangyang Man chieftain Xiang Tianbao and others, more than ten thousand families, relied on difficult terrain and made trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Xiangyang Man chieftain Xiang Tianbao and others, more than ten thousand families, relied on difficult terrain and made trouble.

sentences.zh: 及師還，護率軍討平之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Hu led troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Yuwen Hu led troops to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 初行六官，拜小司空。

translations.literal: When the Six Offices system was first implemented, he was appointed junior minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices system was first implemented, he was appointed junior minister of works.

sentences.zh: 太祖西巡至牽屯山，遇疾，馳驛召護。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor on a western tour reached Qiantun Mount, fell ill, and sent an express courier to summon Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai on a western tour reached Qiantun Mount, fell ill, and sent an express courier to summon Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 護至涇州見太祖，而太祖疾已綿篤。

translations.literal: Hu reached Jing Province and saw the Grand Progenitor, but the Grand Progenitor's illness was already grave.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu reached Jing Province and saw Yuwen Tai, but Yuwen Tai's illness was already grave.

sentences.zh: 謂護曰：「吾形容若此，必是不濟。

translations.literal: He said to Hu: "My appearance is like this; surely I will not recover.
translations.idiomatic: He said to Yuwen Hu: "My appearance is like this; surely I will not recover.

sentences.zh: 諸子幼小，寇賊未寧，天下之事，屬之於汝，宜勉力以成吾志。

translations.literal: My sons are young; bandits and enemies are not yet pacified; affairs of the realm are entrusted to you—you should strive with effort to fulfill my intent.
translations.idiomatic: My sons are young; bandits and enemies are not yet pacified; affairs of the realm are entrusted to you—you should strive with effort to fulfill my intent.

sentences.zh: 」護涕泣奉命。

translations.literal: " Hu wept tears and accepted the command.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuwen Hu wept and accepted the command.

sentences.zh: 行至雲陽而太祖崩。

translations.literal: When they reached Yunyang, the Grand Progenitor died.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Yunyang, Yuwen Tai died.

sentences.zh: 護秘之，至長安乃發喪。

translations.literal: Hu kept it secret; only when reaching Chang'an did he announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu kept it secret; only when reaching Chang'an did he announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 時嗣子沖弱，強寇在近，人情不安。

translations.literal: At the time the heir was young and weak; powerful enemies were near; people's hearts were unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the heir was young and weak; powerful enemies were near; people's hearts were unsettled.

sentences.zh: 護綱紀內外，撫循文武，於是衆心乃定。

translations.literal: Hu maintained order inside and outside and comforted civil and military officers; thus the hearts of the multitude were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu maintained order inside and outside and comforted civil and military officers; thus the hearts of the multitude were settled.

sentences.zh: 先是，太祖常云「我得胡力」。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Grand Progenitor often said "I get Hu's strength."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yuwen Tai often said "I get Hu's strength."

sentences.zh: 當時莫曉其旨，至是，人以護字當之。

translations.literal: At the time no one understood the meaning; now people matched it to Hu's courtesy name.
translations.idiomatic: At the time no one understood the meaning; now people matched it to Yuwen Hu's courtesy name Saba.

sentences.zh: 尋拜柱國。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed pillar-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed pillar-of-state.

sentences.zh: 太祖山陵畢，護以天命有歸，遣人諷魏帝，遂行禪代之事。

translations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor's tomb rites were completed, Hu, because the Mandate had a destination, sent men to hint to the Wei emperor, and thereupon carried out the abdication succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuwen Tai's tomb rites were completed, Yuwen Hu, because the Mandate had a destination, sent men to hint to the Wei emperor, and thereupon carried out the abdication succession.

sentences.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，拜大司馬，封晉國公，邑一萬戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, Hu was appointed grand marshal, enfeoffed as Duke of Jin state, fief ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, Yuwen Hu was appointed grand marshal, enfeoffed as Duke of Jin, with a fief of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 趙貴、獨孤信等謀襲護，護因貴入朝，遂執之，黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhao Gui, Dugu Xin, and others plotted to attack Hu; Hu, when Gui entered court, seized him; accomplices all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gui, Dugu Xin, and others plotted to attack Yuwen Hu; when Zhao Gui entered court, Yuwen Hu seized him; accomplices all were executed.

sentences.zh: 拜大冢宰。

translations.literal: He was appointed chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief minister.

sentences.zh: 時司會李植、軍司馬孫恆等，在太祖之朝，久居權要。

translations.literal: At the time Director of Audits Li Zhi, army secretary Sun Heng, and others, in the Grand Progenitor's court, had long held power positions.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Director of Audits Li Zhi, army secretary Sun Heng, and others, in Yuwen Tai's court, had long held power positions.

sentences.zh: 見護執政，恐不見容。

translations.literal: Seeing Hu in power, they feared they would not be tolerated.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Yuwen Hu in power, they feared they would not be tolerated.

sentences.zh: 乃密要宮伯乙弗鳳、張光洛、賀拔提、元進等為腹心，說帝曰：「護誅

translations.literal: They secretly recruited palace guards Yifu Feng, Zhang Guangluo, Heba Ti, Yuan Jin, and others as confidants, and said to the emperor: "Since Duke Hu executed
translations.idiomatic: They secretly recruited palace guards Yifu Feng, Zhang Guangluo, Heba Ti, Yuan Jin, and others as confidants, and said to the emperor: "Since Duke Hu executed

translations.literal: (Chao)
translations.idiomatic: (Chao)

sentences.zh: 〔趙〕貴以來，威權日盛，謀臣宿將，爭往附之，大小政事，皆決於護。

translations.literal: [Zhao] Gui, his authority grows daily; strategists and veteran generals all rush to attach to him; great and small government affairs are all decided by Hu.
translations.idiomatic: [Zhao] Gui, his authority grows daily; strategists and veteran generals all rush to attach to him; great and small government affairs are all decided by Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 以臣觀之，將不守臣節，恐其滋蔓，願早圖之。

translations.literal: In our view, he will not keep minister's conduct; fearing it spreads further, we wish you would plan against him early."
translations.idiomatic: In our view, he will not keep minister's conduct; fearing it spreads further, we wish you would plan against him early."

sentences.zh: 」帝然其言。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed with their words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed with their words.

sentences.zh: 鳳等又曰：「以先王之聖明，猶委植、恆以朝政，今若左提右挈，何向不成。

translations.literal: Feng and others also said: "With the late king's sage clarity, he still entrusted Zhi and Heng with court government; now if left hand lifts and right hand supports, what could not succeed?
translations.idiomatic: Feng and others also said: "With the late king's sage clarity, he still entrusted Li Zhi and Sun Heng with court government; now if left hand lifts and right hand supports, what could not succeed?

sentences.zh: 且晉公常云我今夾輔陛下，欲行周公之事。

translations.literal: Moreover Duke of Jin often says 'I now flank and assist Your Majesty, wishing to perform the Duke of Zhou's affairs.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Duke of Jin often says 'I now flank and assist Your Majesty, wishing to perform the Duke of Zhou's affairs.'

sentences.zh: 臣聞周公攝政七年，然後復子明辟，陛下今日，豈能七年若此乎。

translations.literal: We hear the Duke of Zhou held regency seven years, then restored the son to clear rule—Your Majesty today, could you seven years like this?
translations.idiomatic: We hear the Duke of Zhou held regency seven years, then restored the son to clear rule—Your Majesty today, could you seven years like this?

sentences.zh: 深願不疑。

translations.literal: We deeply wish you would not doubt."
translations.idiomatic: We deeply wish you would not doubt."

sentences.zh: 」帝愈信之。

translations.literal: The emperor believed them all the more.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed them all the more.

sentences.zh: 數將武士於後園講習，為執縛之勢。

translations.literal: He repeatedly led warriors in the rear garden to drill, in the posture of binding and seizing.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly led warriors in the rear garden to drill, in the posture of binding and seizing.

sentences.zh: 護微知之，乃出植為梁州刺史，恆為潼州刺史，欲遏其謀。

translations.literal: Hu slightly knew of it; he thereupon sent Zhi out as governor of Liang Province and Heng out as governor of Tong Province, wishing to check their plot.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu slightly knew of it; he thereupon sent Li Zhi out as governor of Liang Province and Sun Heng out as governor of Tong Province, wishing to check their plot.

sentences.zh: 後帝思植等，每欲召之。

translations.literal: Later the emperor missed Zhi and the others and often wished to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor missed Li Zhi and the others and often wished to summon them.

sentences.zh: 護諫曰：「天下至親，不過兄弟。

translations.literal: Hu remonstrated, saying: "The closest kin under Heaven is nothing beyond brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu remonstrated, saying: "The closest kin under Heaven is nothing beyond brothers.

sentences.zh: 若兄弟自構嫌隙，他人何易可親。

translations.literal: If brothers themselves build suspicion and rifts, how easily can others be trusted?
translations.idiomatic: If brothers themselves build suspicion and rifts, how easily can others be trusted?

sentences.zh: 太祖以陛下富於春秋，顧命托臣以後事。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor, because Your Majesty was rich in youth, entrusted me with later affairs in a deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai, because Your Majesty was still young, entrusted me with later affairs in a deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 臣旣情兼家國，寔願竭其股肱。

translations.literal: I am affection bound to family and state alike and truly wish to exhaust my limbs in service.
translations.idiomatic: I am affection bound to family and state alike and truly wish to exhaust my limbs in service.

sentences.zh: 若使陛下親覽萬機，威加四海，臣死之日，猶生之年。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty personally oversees the myriad affairs and authority extends over the four seas, the day of my death would still be like the day of my life.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty personally oversees the myriad affairs and authority extends over the four seas, the day of my death would still be like the day of my life.

sentences.zh: 但恐除臣之後，姦回得逞其欲，非唯不利陛下，亦恐社稷危亡。

translations.literal: But I fear that after removing me, wicked men will achieve their desires—not only to Your Majesty's harm, but also I fear the altars of state will be endangered and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: But I fear that after removing me, wicked men will achieve their desires—not only to Your Majesty's harm, but also I fear the altars of state will be endangered and destroyed.

sentences.zh: 臣所以勤勤懇懇，干觸天威者，但不負太祖之顧託，保安國家之鼎祚耳。

translations.literal: The reason I earnestly and repeatedly offend Heaven's majesty is only that I not fail the Grand Progenitor's entrustment and may secure the dynasty's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: The reason I earnestly and repeatedly offend Heaven's majesty is only that I not fail Yuwen Tai's entrustment and may secure the dynasty's foundation.

sentences.zh: 不意陛下不照愚臣款誠，忽生疑阻。

translations.literal: I did not expect Your Majesty would not illuminate this foolish minister's sincere devotion and suddenly give rise to suspicion and obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: I did not expect Your Majesty would not illuminate this foolish minister's sincere devotion and suddenly give rise to suspicion and obstruction.

sentences.zh: 且臣旣為天子兄，復為國家宰輔，知更何求而懷冀望。

translations.literal: Moreover I am both the Son of Heaven's elder brother and again the state's chief minister—knowing what more could I seek and yet harbor ambitious hopes?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover I am both the Son of Heaven's elder brother and again the state's chief minister—knowing what more could I seek and yet harbor ambitious hopes?

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下有以明臣，無惑讒人之口。

translations.literal: I humbly wish Your Majesty would have means to clarify me and not be deluded by slanderers' mouths."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish Your Majesty would have means to clarify me and not be deluded by slanderers' mouths."

sentences.zh: 」因泣涕，久之乃止。

translations.literal: Thereupon he wept tears; only after long did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he wept; only after long did he stop.

sentences.zh: 帝猶猜之。

translations.literal: The emperor still suspected him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor still suspected him.

sentences.zh: 鳳等益懼，密謀滋甚。

translations.literal: Feng and the others grew all the more afraid; secret plotting grew ever deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and the others grew all the more afraid; secret plotting grew ever deeper.

sentences.zh: 遂克日將召羣公入醼，執護誅之。

translations.literal: They thereupon set a day when they would summon the assembled nobles to a banquet, seize Hu, and execute him.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon set a day when they would summon the assembled nobles to a banquet, seize Yuwen Hu, and execute him.

sentences.zh: 光洛具以其前後謀告護，護乃召柱國賀蘭祥、小司馬尉遲綱等，以鳳謀告之。

translations.literal: Guangluo fully reported their earlier and later plot to Hu; Hu thereupon summoned Pillar-of-State Helan Xiang, junior marshal Yuchi Gang, and others, and told them of Feng's plot.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangluo fully reported their earlier and later plot to Yuwen Hu; Yuwen Hu thereupon summoned Pillar-of-State Helan Xiang, junior marshal Yuchi Gang, and others, and told them of Yifu Feng's plot.

sentences.zh: 祥等竝勸護廢帝。

translations.literal: Xiang and the others all urged Hu to depose the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Helan Xiang and the others all urged Yuwen Hu to depose the emperor.

sentences.zh: 時綱總領禁兵，護乃遣綱入宮，召鳳等議事，及出，以次執送護第。

translations.literal: At the time Gang commanded the forbidden troops; Hu thereupon sent Gang into the palace to summon Feng and the others to discuss affairs, and when they came out, seized them in order and sent them to Hu's residence.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yuchi Gang commanded the forbidden troops; Yuwen Hu thereupon sent Gang into the palace to summon Feng and the others to discuss affairs, and when they came out, seized them in order and sent them to Yuwen Hu's residence.

sentences.zh: 因罷散宿衛兵，遣祥逼帝，幽於舊邸。

translations.literal: He thereupon dismissed and dispersed the night-guard troops, sent Xiang to compel the emperor, and confined him in the old residence.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon dismissed and dispersed the night-guard troops, sent Helan Xiang to compel the emperor, and confined him in the old residence.

sentences.zh: 於是召諸公卿畢集，護流涕謂曰：「先王起自布衣，躬親行陣，勤勞王業，三十餘年。

translations.literal: Thereupon he summoned all the nobles and ministers to assemble; Hu weeping said to them: "The late king rose from common cloth, personally entered battle lines, toiled at the royal enterprise more than thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he summoned all the nobles and ministers to assemble; Yuwen Hu weeping said to them: "The late king rose from common cloth, personally entered battle lines, and toiled at the royal enterprise more than thirty years.

sentences.zh: 寇賊未平，奄棄萬國。

translations.literal: Bandits and enemies were not yet pacified when suddenly he abandoned the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits and enemies were not yet pacified when suddenly he abandoned the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 寡人地則猶子，親受顧命。

translations.literal: I in status am like a younger son and personally received the deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: I in status am like a younger son and personally received the deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 以略陽公旣居正嫡，與公等立而奉之，革魏興周，為四海主。

translations.literal: Because Duke of Lueyang already held the legitimate succession, with you nobles we established and served him, changed Wei and raised Zhou, and made him master of the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Because Duke of Lueyang already held the legitimate succession, with you nobles we established and served him, changed Wei and raised Zhou, and made him master of the four seas.

sentences.zh: 自卽位以來，荒淫無度，昵近羣小，疏忌骨肉，大臣重將，咸欲誅夷。

translations.literal: Since ascending the throne he has been dissolute without measure, intimate with petty men, distant and jealous of kin, and great ministers and important generals—all wished to be executed and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Since ascending the throne he has been dissolute without measure, intimate with petty men, distant and jealous of kin, and great ministers and important generals—all wished to be executed and destroyed.

sentences.zh: 若此謀遂行，社稷必致傾覆。

translations.literal: If this plot had been carried out, the altars of state would surely have been overturned.
translations.idiomatic: If this plot had been carried out, the altars of state would surely have been overturned.

sentences.zh: 寡人若死，將何面目以見先王。

translations.literal: If I die, with what face could I see the late king?
translations.idiomatic: If I die, with what face could I see the late king?

sentences.zh: 今日寧負略陽，不負社稷爾。

translations.literal: Today I would rather fail Duke of Lueyang than fail the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Today I would rather fail Duke of Lueyang than fail the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 寧都公年德兼茂，仁孝聖慈，四海歸心，萬方注意。

translations.literal: Duke of Ning in years and virtue is abundant together, benevolent, filial, sage, and compassionate; the four seas turn their hearts to him; the myriad regions fix their attention on him.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Ning in years and virtue is abundant together, benevolent, filial, sage, and compassionate; the four seas turn their hearts to him; the myriad regions fix their attention on him.

sentences.zh: 今欲廢昏立明，公等以為如何？

translations.literal: Now we wish to depose the dark and establish the bright—what do you nobles think?"
translations.idiomatic: Now we wish to depose the dark and establish the bright—what do you nobles think?"

sentences.zh: 」羣臣咸曰：「此公之家事，敢不惟命是聽。

translations.literal: The assembled ministers all said: "This is your Grace's family affair—we dare not but obey your command."
translations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers all said: "This is your Grace's family affair—we dare not but obey your command."

sentences.zh: 」於是斬鳳等於門外，幷誅植、恆等。

translations.literal: Thereupon Feng and the others were beheaded outside the gate; Zhi, Heng, and the others were also executed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yifu Feng and the others were beheaded outside the gate; Li Zhi, Sun Heng, and the others were also executed.

sentences.zh: 尋亦弒帝。

translations.literal: Soon the emperor was also assassinated.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the emperor was also assassinated.

sentences.zh: 迎世宗於岐州而立之。

translations.literal: They welcomed Shizong from Qi Province and established him.
translations.idiomatic: They welcomed Emperor Ming from Qi Province and established him.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜太師，賜輅車冕服。

translations.literal: In the second year, Hu was appointed grand preceptor and granted carriage, cap, and robes of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Yuwen Hu was appointed grand preceptor and granted carriage, cap, and robes of investiture.

sentences.zh: 封子至為崇業郡公。

translations.literal: His son Zhi was enfeoffed as Duke of Chongye commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhi was enfeoffed as Duke of Chongye commandery.

sentences.zh: 初改雍州刺史為牧，以護為之，幷賜金石之樂。

translations.literal: When the governor of Yong Province was first changed to governor-general, Hu was made such and was also granted stone-and-metal music.
translations.idiomatic: When the governor of Yong Province was first changed to governor-general, Yuwen Hu was made such and was also granted stone-and-metal music.

sentences.zh: 武成元年，護上表歸政，帝許之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng, Hu submitted a memorial returning government; the emperor permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wucheng (559), Yuwen Hu submitted a memorial returning government; the emperor permitted it.

sentences.zh: 軍國大事尚委於護。

translations.literal: Great military affairs were still entrusted to Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Great military affairs were still entrusted to Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 帝性聰睿，有識量，護深憚之。

translations.literal: The emperor by nature was clever and perceptive, with judgment and capacity; Hu deeply feared him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor by nature was clever and perceptive, with judgment and capacity; Yuwen Hu deeply feared him.

sentences.zh: 有李安者，本以鼎俎得寵於護，稍被升擢，位至膳部下大夫。

translations.literal: There was one Li An who originally through kitchen service gained Hu's favor; gradually he was promoted and reached the post of lower grandee of the victuals ministry.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Li An who originally through kitchen service gained Yuwen Hu's favor; gradually he was promoted and reached the post of lower grandee of the victuals ministry.

sentences.zh: 至是，護乃密令安因進食於帝，加以毒藥。

translations.literal: At this time Hu secretly ordered An, when presenting food to the emperor, to add poison.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Yuwen Hu secretly ordered Li An, when presenting food to the emperor, to add poison.

sentences.zh: 帝遂寢疾而崩。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon took to bed with illness and died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon took to bed with illness and died.

sentences.zh: 護立高祖，百官總己以聽於護。

translations.literal: Hu established Gaozu; the hundred officials all turned to themselves and took orders from Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu established Yuwen Yong as Gaozu; the hundred officials all turned to themselves and took orders from Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖創業，卽與突厥和親，謀為掎角，共圖高氏。

translations.literal: Initially, when the Grand Progenitor founded the enterprise, he immediately allied by marriage with the Turks, planning a pincer, jointly to scheme against the Gao clan.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when Yuwen Tai founded the enterprise, he immediately allied by marriage with the Turks, planning a pincer, jointly to scheme against the Gao clan of Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 是年，乃遣柱國楊忠與突厥東伐。

translations.literal: That year he thereupon dispatched Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong with the Turks to campaign east.
translations.idiomatic: That year he thereupon dispatched Pillar-of-State Yang Zhong with the Turks to campaign east.

sentences.zh: 破齊長城，至幷州而還。

translations.literal: They broke Northern Qi's Great Wall, reached Bing Province, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They broke Northern Qi's Great Wall, reached Bing Province, and returned.

sentences.zh: 期後年更舉，南北相應。

translations.literal: They planned another campaign the following year, north and south responding to each other.
translations.idiomatic: They planned another campaign the following year, north and south responding to each other.

sentences.zh: 齊主大懼。

translations.literal: The Northern Qi ruler was greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Qi ruler was greatly afraid.

sentences.zh: 先是，護母閻姬與皇第四姑及諸戚屬，並沒在齊，皆被幽縶。

translations.literal: Earlier, Hu's mother Lady Yan and the imperial fourth aunt and various kin, all were captured in Northern Qi and were all imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yuwen Hu's mother Lady Yan and the imperial fourth aunt and various kin, all were captured in Northern Qi and were all imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 護居宰相之後，每遣間使尋求，莫知音息。

translations.literal: After Hu held the chancellor's post, he repeatedly sent secret envoys to seek them; no word of their fate was heard.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuwen Hu held the chancellor's post, he repeatedly sent secret envoys to seek them; no word of their fate was heard.

sentences.zh: 至是，並許還朝，且請和好。

translations.literal: At this time all were permitted to return to court and also sought reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: At this time all were permitted to return to court and Northern Qi also sought reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 四年，皇姑先至。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the imperial aunt arrived first.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the imperial aunt arrived first.

sentences.zh: 齊主以護旣當權重，乃留其母，以為後圖。

translations.literal: The Northern Qi ruler, because Hu already held heavy power, thereupon detained his mother as a plan for later.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Qi ruler, because Yuwen Hu already held heavy power, thereupon detained his mother as a plan for later.

sentences.zh: 仍令人為閻作書報護曰：

translations.literal: He still had someone write a letter for Lady Yan reporting to Hu, saying:
translations.idiomatic: He still had someone write a letter for Lady Yan reporting to Yuwen Hu, saying:

sentences.zh: 天地隔塞，子母異所，三十餘年，存亡斷絕，肝腸之痛，不能自勝。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth are blocked and severed; mother and son are in different places; more than thirty years, life and death cut off; the pain of liver and intestines cannot be overcome.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth are blocked and severed; mother and son are in different places; more than thirty years, life and death cut off; the pain is more than I can bear.

sentences.zh: 想汝悲思之懷，復何可處。

translations.literal: Thinking of your grief and longing, how again can it be borne?
translations.idiomatic: Thinking of your grief and longing, how again can it be borne?

sentences.zh: 吾自念十九入汝家，今已八十矣。

translations.literal: I myself recall entering your household at nineteen; now I am already eighty.
translations.idiomatic: I myself recall entering your household at nineteen; now I am already eighty.

sentences.zh: 旣逢喪亂，備嘗艱阻。

translations.literal: Having encountered turmoil and ruin, I have fully tasted hardship and obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Having encountered turmoil and ruin, I have fully tasted hardship and obstruction.

sentences.zh: 恆冀汝等長成，得見一日安樂。

translations.literal: I constantly hoped you would grow to maturity and see one day of peace and joy.
translations.idiomatic: I constantly hoped you would grow to maturity and see one day of peace and joy.

sentences.zh: 何期罪釁深重，存沒分離。

translations.literal: Who expected guilt and offense so deep and heavy, living and dead separated.
translations.idiomatic: Who expected guilt and offense so deep and heavy, living and dead separated.

sentences.zh: 吾凡生汝輩三男三女，今日目下，不睹一人。

translations.literal: In all I bore you three sons and three daughters; today before my eyes I do not see a single one.
translations.idiomatic: In all I bore you three sons and three daughters; today before my eyes I do not see a single one.

sentences.zh: 興言及此，悲纏肌骨。

translations.literal: Speaking of this, grief binds muscle and bone.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of this, grief binds muscle and bone.

sentences.zh: 賴皇齊恩恤，差安衰暮。

translations.literal: Relying on Great Qi's gracious pity, I am somewhat at ease in my declining years.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on Great Qi's gracious pity, I am somewhat at ease in my declining years.

sentences.zh: 又得汝楊氏姑及汝叔母紇干、汝嫂劉新婦等同居，頗亦自適。

translations.literal: I also have your Yang paternal aunt and your uncle's wife Hegan and your sister-in-law Lady Liu Xinfu and others living together; it is also rather comfortable.
translations.idiomatic: I also have your Yang paternal aunt and your uncle's wife Hegan and your sister-in-law Lady Liu Xinfu and others living together; it is also rather comfortable.

sentences.zh: 但為微有耳疾，大語方聞。

translations.literal: Only I have slight ear ailment; only loud speech can be heard.
translations.idiomatic: Only I have slight ear ailment; only loud speech can be heard.

sentences.zh: 行動飲食，幸無多恙。

translations.literal: In movement and in eating and drinking, fortunately there is not much illness.
translations.idiomatic: In movement and in eating and drinking, fortunately there is not much illness.

sentences.zh: 今大齊聖德遠被，特降鴻慈，旣許歸吾於汝，又聽先致音耗。

translations.literal: Now Great Qi's sage virtue extends far; it specially sends down vast kindness; it has already permitted my return to you and also allows first sending word.
translations.idiomatic: Now Great Qi's sage virtue extends far; it specially sends down vast kindness; it has already permitted my return to you and also allows first sending word.

sentences.zh: 積稔長悲，豁然獲展。

translations.literal: Long years of accumulated grief suddenly obtain release.
translations.idiomatic: Long years of accumulated grief suddenly obtain release.

sentences.zh: 此乃仁侔造化，將何報德！

translations.literal: This is benevolence equal to creation and transformation—how could I repay the virtue!
translations.idiomatic: This is benevolence equal to creation and transformation—how could I repay the virtue!

sentences.zh: 汝與吾別之時，年尚幼小，以前家事，或不委曲。

translations.literal: When you parted from me, you were still young; regarding earlier household affairs, perhaps you do not know the full details.
translations.idiomatic: When you parted from me, you were still young; regarding earlier household affairs, perhaps you do not know the full details.

sentences.zh: 昔在武川鎮生汝兄弟，大者屬鼠，次者屬兔，汝身屬蛇。

translations.literal: Formerly at Wuchuan garrison your brothers were born—the eldest belongs to the rat, the next to the rabbit, and you yourself to the snake.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly at Wuchuan garrison your brothers were born—the eldest belongs to the rat, the next to the rabbit, and you yourself to the snake.

sentences.zh: 鮮于修禮起日，吾之闔家大小，先在博陵郡住。

translations.literal: On the day Xianyu Xiuli rose, my whole household large and small was first living in Boling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Xianyu Xiuli rose, my whole household large and small was first living in Boling commandery.

sentences.zh: 相將欲向左人城，行至唐河之北，被定州官軍打敗。

translations.literal: We were about to go together toward Zuoren city; when we reached north of the Tang River, we were defeated by Ding Province government troops.
translations.idiomatic: We were about to go together toward Zuoren city; when we reached north of the Tang River, we were defeated by Ding Province government troops.

sentences.zh: 汝祖及二叔，時俱戰亡。

translations.literal: Your grandfather and two uncles at the time all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Your grandfather and two uncles at the time all died in battle.

sentences.zh: 汝叔母賀拔及兒元寶，汝叔母紇干及兒菩提，並吾與汝六人，同被擒捉入定州城。

translations.literal: Your uncle's wife Heba and son Yuanbao, your uncle's wife Hegan and son Puti, together with me and you six people, were all captured and taken into Ding Province city.
translations.idiomatic: Your uncle's wife Heba and son Yuanbao, your uncle's wife Hegan and son Puti, together with me and you six people, were all captured and taken into Ding Province city.

sentences.zh: 未幾間，將吾及汝送與元寶掌。

translations.literal: Before long they sent me and you to Yuanbao's custody.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they sent me and you to Yuanbao's custody.

sentences.zh: 賀拔、紇干，各別分散。

translations.literal: Heba and Hegan each separately dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Heba and Hegan each separately dispersed.

sentences.zh: 寶掌見汝云：「我識其祖翁，形狀相似。

translations.literal: Baozhang saw you and said: "I recognize his grandfather—the shape is similar."
translations.idiomatic: Baozhang saw you and said: "I recognize his grandfather—the shape is similar."

sentences.zh: 」時寶掌營在唐城內。

translations.literal: At the time Baozhang's camp was inside Tang city.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Baozhang's camp was inside Tang city.

sentences.zh: 經停三日，寶掌所掠得男夫、婦女，可六七十人，悉送向京。

translations.literal: After stopping three days, the men and women Baozhang had plundered, about sixty or seventy people, were all sent toward the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After stopping three days, the men and women Baozhang had plundered, about sixty or seventy people, were all sent toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 吾時與汝同被送限。

translations.literal: At the time I and you were sent together under guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the time I and you were sent together under guard.

sentences.zh: 至定州城南，夜宿同鄉人姬庫根家。

translations.literal: Reaching south of Ding Province city, at night we lodged at fellow townsman Ji Kugen's house.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching south of Ding Province city, at night we lodged at fellow townsman Ji Kugen's house.

sentences.zh: 茹茹奴望見鮮于修禮營火，語吾云：「我今走向本軍。

translations.literal: Ruru slave saw Xianyu Xiuli's camp fires and said to me: "I now will go toward the main army."
translations.idiomatic: Ruru slave saw Xianyu Xiuli's camp fires and said to me: "I now will go toward the main army."

sentences.zh: 」旣至營，遂告吾輩在此。

translations.literal: When he reached the camp, he thereupon reported that we were here.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the camp, he thereupon reported that we were here.

sentences.zh: 明旦日出，汝叔將兵邀截，吾及汝等，還得向營。

translations.literal: The next morning at sunrise your uncle led troops to intercept; I and you and the others were able to return toward the camp.
translations.idiomatic: The next morning at sunrise your uncle led troops to intercept; I and you and the others were able to return toward the camp.

sentences.zh: 汝時年十二，共吾並乘馬隨軍，可不記此事緣由也？

translations.literal: You at the time were twelve; together with me you both rode horses following the army—you surely remember this matter's origin, do you not?
translations.idiomatic: You at the time were twelve; together with me you both rode horses following the army—you surely remember this matter's origin, do you not?

sentences.zh: 於後，吾共汝在受陽住。

translations.literal: Afterward I and you lived at Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward I and you lived at Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 時元寶、菩提及汝姑兒賀蘭盛洛，幷汝身四人同學。

translations.literal: At the time Yuanbao, Puti, and your aunt's son Helan Shenglo, together with you yourself, four people studied together.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yuanbao, Puti, and your aunt's son Helan Shenglo, together with you yourself, four people studied together.

sentences.zh: 博士姓成，為人嚴惡，

translations.literal: The instructor surnamed Cheng was by nature stern and harsh,
translations.idiomatic: The instructor surnamed Cheng was by nature stern and harsh,

translations.literal: (Ling)
translations.idiomatic: (Ling)

sentences.zh: 〔汝〕等四人謀欲加害。

translations.literal: [You] and the other four plotted to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: [You] and the other four plotted to kill him.

sentences.zh: 吾共汝叔母等聞之，各捉其兒打之。

translations.literal: I and your uncles' wives and others heard of it; each seized her son and beat him.
translations.idiomatic: I and your uncles' wives and others heard of it; each seized her son and beat him.

sentences.zh: 唯盛洛無母，獨不被打。

translations.literal: Only Shenglo had no mother; alone he was not beaten.
translations.idiomatic: Only Shenglo had no mother; alone he was not beaten.

sentences.zh: 其後爾朱天柱亡歲，賀拔阿斗泥在關西，遣人迎家累。

translations.literal: Afterward, in the year Erzhu Tianzhu died, Heba Adouni was in Guanxi and sent men to welcome family dependents.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, in the year Erzhu Tianzhu died, Heba Adouni was in Guanxi and sent men to welcome family dependents.

sentences.zh: 時汝叔亦遣奴來富迎汝及盛洛等。

translations.literal: At the time your uncle also sent a slave named Laifu to welcome you and Shenglo and the others.
translations.idiomatic: At the time your uncle also sent a slave named Laifu to welcome you and Shenglo and the others.

sentences.zh: 汝時著緋綾袍、銀裝帶，盛洛著紫織成纈通身袍、黃綾裏，並乘騾同去。

translations.literal: You at the time wore a crimson gauze robe and silver-decorated belt; Shenglo wore a purple woven patterned robe over the whole body with yellow gauze lining; you both rode mules and went together.
translations.idiomatic: You at the time wore a crimson gauze robe and silver-decorated belt; Shenglo wore a purple woven patterned robe over the whole body with yellow gauze lining; you both rode mules and went together.

sentences.zh: 盛洛小於汝，汝等三人並呼吾作「阿摩敦」。

translations.literal: Shenglo was younger than you; you three all called me "Amodun."
translations.idiomatic: Shenglo was younger than you; you three all called me "Amodun."

sentences.zh: 如此之事，當分明記之耳。

translations.literal: Matters like this—you should clearly remember them.
translations.idiomatic: Matters like this—you should clearly remember them.

sentences.zh: 今又寄汝小時所著錦袍表一領，至宜檢看，知吾含悲戚多歷年祀。

translations.literal: Now I also send you the brocade robe with facing you wore in childhood, one piece; when it arrives you should inspect it and know my grief and sorrow have lasted many years.
translations.idiomatic: Now I also send you the brocade robe with facing you wore in childhood, one piece; when it arrives you should inspect it and know my grief and sorrow have lasted many years.

sentences.zh: 屬千載之運，逢大齊之德，矜老開恩，許得相見。

translations.literal: It falls to the fortune of a thousand years to meet Great Qi's virtue; pitying the aged and opening grace, reunion is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: It falls to the fortune of a thousand years to meet Great Qi's virtue; pitying the aged and opening grace, reunion is permitted.

sentences.zh: 一聞此言，死猶不朽，況如今者，勢必聚集。

translations.literal: On hearing these words, death would still be immortal; how much more now, when we must surely gather.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing these words, death would still be immortal; how much more now, when we must surely gather.

sentences.zh: 禽獸草木，母子相依，吾有何罪，與汝分離，今復何福，還望見汝。

translations.literal: Birds and beasts and plants and trees—mother and child rely on each other; what crime have I that I am separated from you; what blessing now that I again may hope to see you?
translations.idiomatic: Birds and beasts and plants and trees—mother and child rely on each other; what crime have I that I am separated from you; what blessing now that I again may hope to see you?

sentences.zh: 言此悲喜，死而更蘇。

translations.literal: Speaking this, joy and grief—dead and again revived.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking this, joy and grief—dead and again revived.

sentences.zh: 世間所有，求皆可得，母子異國，何處可求。

translations.literal: All that exists in the world, if sought, can all be obtained; mother and son in different states—where can it be sought?
translations.idiomatic: All that exists in the world, if sought, can all be obtained; mother and son in different states—where can it be sought?

sentences.zh: 假汝貴極王公，富過山海；

translations.literal: Suppose you were noble to the utmost of kings and dukes, rich beyond mountains and seas;
translations.idiomatic: Suppose you were noble to the utmost of kings and dukes, rich beyond mountains and seas;

sentences.zh: 有一老母，八十之年，飄然千里，死亡旦夕，不得一朝蹔見，不得一日同處，寒不得汝衣，饑不得汝食，汝雖窮榮極盛，光耀世間，汝何用為？

translations.literal: there is one old mother, eighty years, drifting a thousand li, death morning and evening, unable to obtain one morning's brief sight, unable one day to dwell together; cold yet not your clothes, hungry yet not your food—you though exhausted in glory and utmost splendor, shining over the world, of what use are you?
translations.idiomatic: there is one old mother, eighty years, drifting a thousand li, death morning and evening, unable to obtain one morning's brief sight, unable one day to dwell together; cold yet not your clothes, hungry yet not your food—you though exhausted in glory and utmost splendor, shining over the world, of what use are you?

sentences.zh: 于吾何益？

translations.literal: What benefit to me?
translations.idiomatic: What benefit to me?

sentences.zh: 吾今日之前，汝旣不得申其供養，事往何論。

translations.literal: Before today you already could not perform your support; what is past, what need to discuss.
translations.idiomatic: Before today you already could not perform your support; what is past, what need to discuss.

sentences.zh: 今日以後，吾之殘命，唯系於汝，爾戴天履地，中有鬼神，勿云冥昧而可欺負。

translations.literal: From today afterward my remaining life is only bound to you; you tread Heaven and stand on earth—within are ghosts and spirits; do not say darkness and obscurity and so may be deceived and wronged.
translations.idiomatic: From today afterward my remaining life is only bound to you; you tread Heaven and stand on earth—within are ghosts and spirits; do not say darkness and obscurity and so may be deceived and wronged.

sentences.zh: 汝楊氏姑，今雖炎暑，猶能先發。

translations.literal: Your Yang paternal aunt, though now it is blazing summer, still can set out first.
translations.idiomatic: Your Yang paternal aunt, though now it is blazing summer, still can set out first.

sentences.zh: 關河阻遠，隔絕多年，書依常體，慮汝致惑，是以每存款質，兼亦載吾姓名。

translations.literal: Passes and rivers are blocked and far; separated many years; letters follow ordinary form; fearing you would be confused, therefore each time I add pledges and proofs and also record my name.
translations.idiomatic: Passes and rivers are blocked and far; separated many years; letters follow ordinary form; fearing you would be confused, therefore each time I add pledges and proofs and also record my name.

sentences.zh: 當識此理，不以為怪。

translations.literal: You should understand this principle and not regard it as strange.
translations.idiomatic: You should understand this principle and not regard it as strange.

sentences.zh: 護性至孝，得書，悲不自勝，左右莫能仰視。

translations.literal: Hu by nature was supremely filial; receiving the letter, grief could not be overcome; those at his side none could look up.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu by nature was supremely filial; receiving the letter, grief could not be overcome; those at his side none could look up.

sentences.zh: 報書曰：

translations.literal: His reply letter said:
translations.idiomatic: His reply letter said:

sentences.zh: 區宇分崩，遭遇災禍，違離膝下，三十五年。

translations.literal: The realm split and collapsed; I encountered disaster and calamity; parted from beneath your knees thirty-five years.
translations.idiomatic: The realm split and collapsed; I encountered disaster and calamity; parted from beneath your knees thirty-five years.

sentences.zh: 受形稟氣，皆知母子，誰同薩保，如此不孝！

translations.literal: Receiving form and inheriting breath, all know mother and son—who like Saba is so unfilial!
translations.idiomatic: Receiving form and inheriting breath, all know mother and son—who like Saba is so unfilial!

sentences.zh: 宿殃積戾，唯應賜鐘，豈悟網羅，上嬰慈母。

translations.literal: Accumulated misfortune and piled guilt—only death should be granted; who expected the net and snare would reach up to afflict my compassionate mother.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated misfortune and piled guilt—only death should be granted; who expected the net and snare would reach up to afflict my compassionate mother.

sentences.zh: 但立身立行，不負一物，明神有識，宜見哀憐。

translations.literal: But in establishing body and establishing conduct I have not failed a single thing; the bright spirits have knowledge—they should see pity.
translations.idiomatic: But in establishing body and establishing conduct I have not failed a single thing; the bright spirits have knowledge—they should see pity.

sentences.zh: 而子為公侯，母為俘隸，熱不見母熱，寒不見母寒，衣不知有無，食不知饑飽，泯如天地之外，無由暫聞。

translations.literal: Yet the son is duke and marquis while the mother is captive slave; hot yet not seeing mother's heat, cold yet not seeing mother's cold; clothes not knowing whether there are any, food not knowing hunger or fullness—vanished as beyond Heaven and earth, without means briefly to hear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the son is duke and marquis while the mother is captive slave; hot yet not seeing mother's heat, cold yet not seeing mother's cold; clothes not knowing whether there are any, food not knowing hunger or fullness—vanished as beyond Heaven and earth, without means briefly to hear.

sentences.zh: 晝夜悲號，繼之以血，分懷冤酷，終此一生，死若有知，冀奉見於泉下爾。

translations.literal: Day and night wailing, continuing with blood; parting harbors bitter cruelty—through this one life; if death has knowledge, I hope to serve and see you beneath the springs.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night wailing, continuing with blood; parting harbors bitter cruelty—through this one life; if death has knowledge, I hope to serve and see you beneath the springs.

sentences.zh: 不謂齊朝解網，惠以德音，摩敦、四姑，並許矜放。

translations.literal: I did not expect Northern Qi court would release the net, grace with virtuous word; Modun and the fourth aunt were all permitted compassionate release.
translations.idiomatic: I did not expect Northern Qi court would release the net, grace with virtuous word; Modun and the fourth aunt were all permitted compassionate release.

sentences.zh: 初聞此旨，魂爽飛越，號天叩地，不能自勝。

translations.literal: On first hearing this intent, soul and spirit flew and leaped; I cried to Heaven and knocked on earth and could not overcome.
translations.idiomatic: On first hearing this intent, soul and spirit flew and leaped; I cried to Heaven and knocked on earth and could not overcome.

sentences.zh: 四姑卽蒙禮送，平安入境，以今月十八日於河東拜見。

translations.literal: The fourth aunt immediately received ceremonial escort, peacefully entered the border; on the eighteenth of this month at Hedong I paid respects and saw her.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth aunt immediately received ceremonial escort, peacefully entered the border; on the eighteenth of this month at Hedong I paid respects and saw her.

sentences.zh: 遙奉顏色，崩動肝腸。

translations.literal: From afar receiving her countenance, liver and intestines collapsed and shook.
translations.idiomatic: From afar receiving her countenance, liver and intestines collapsed and shook.

sentences.zh: 但離絕多年，存亡阻隔，相見之始，口未忍言，唯敘齊朝寬弘，每存大德。

translations.literal: But separated many years, life and death blocked; at the beginning of meeting, mouth could not bear to speak; only narrated Northern Qi court's broad magnanimity, each time preserving great virtue.
translations.idiomatic: But separated many years, life and death blocked; at the beginning of meeting, mouth could not bear to speak; only narrated Northern Qi court's broad magnanimity, each time preserving great virtue.

sentences.zh: 云與摩敦雖處宮禁，常蒙優禮，今者來鄴，恩遇彌隆。

translations.literal: She said that though Modun was in palace confinement, he constantly received generous rites; now coming to Ye, gracious treatment was ever more abundant.
translations.idiomatic: She said that though Modun was in palace confinement, he constantly received generous rites; now coming to Ye, gracious treatment was ever more abundant.

sentences.zh: 矜哀聽許摩敦垂敕，曲盡悲酷，備述家事。

translations.literal: Pitying and hearing permission for Modun to send down command, fully narrating bitter cruelty, fully relating household affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying and hearing permission for Modun to send down command, fully narrating bitter cruelty, fully relating household affairs.

sentences.zh: 伏讀未周，五情屠割。

translations.literal: Humbly reading, not yet finished, the five emotions were butchered and cut.
translations.idiomatic: Humbly reading, not yet finished, the five emotions were butchered and cut.

sentences.zh: 書中所道，無事敢忘。

translations.literal: What the letter stated—no matter I dare forget.
translations.idiomatic: What the letter stated—no matter I dare forget.

sentences.zh: 摩敦年尊，又加憂苦，常謂寢膳貶損，或多遺漏；

translations.literal: Modun is advanced in years and again added worry and suffering; I often supposed sleep and meals were diminished or many omissions;
translations.idiomatic: Modun is advanced in years and again added worry and suffering; I often supposed sleep and meals were diminished or many omissions;

sentences.zh: 伏奉論述，次第分明。

translations.literal: humbly receiving your narration, sequence clear and distinct.
translations.idiomatic: humbly receiving your narration, sequence clear and distinct.

sentences.zh: 一則以悲，一則以喜。

translations.literal: One part grief, one part joy.
translations.idiomatic: One part grief, one part joy.

sentences.zh: 當鄉里破敗之日，薩保年已十餘歲，鄰曲舊事，猶自記憶；

translations.literal: When the hometown was broken and ruined, Saba was already more than ten years; neighborhood old affairs still himself remembers;
translations.idiomatic: When the hometown was broken and ruined, Saba was already more than ten years; neighborhood old affairs still himself remembers;

sentences.zh: 況家門禍難，親戚流離，奉辭時節，先後慈訓，刻肌刻骨，常纏心腑。

translations.literal: how much more household gate disaster and difficulty, kin scattered and displaced, times of parting words, earlier and later compassionate instruction—carved in flesh and carved in bone, constantly binding heart and bowels.
translations.idiomatic: how much more household gate disaster and difficulty, kin scattered and displaced, times of parting words, earlier and later compassionate instruction—carved in flesh and carved in bone, constantly binding heart and bowels.

sentences.zh: 天長喪亂，四海橫流。

translations.literal: Heaven long in turmoil and ruin; the four seas flow crosswise.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven long in turmoil and ruin; the four seas flow crosswise.

sentences.zh: 太祖乘時，齊朝撫運，兩河、三輔，各值神機。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor seized the time; Northern Qi court received the mandate; the two rivers and three auxiliaries each met divine opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai seized the time; Northern Qi court received the mandate; the two rivers and three auxiliaries each met divine opportunity.

sentences.zh: 原其事蹟，非相負背。

translations.literal: Examining the matter's traces, it was not mutual betrayal.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the matter's traces, it was not mutual betrayal.

sentences.zh: 太祖升遐，未定天保，薩保屬當猶子之長，親受顧命。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor ascended to the distant; Heaven's protection was not yet settled; Saba happened to be eldest among younger sons and personally received the deathbed charge.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai ascended to the distant; Heaven's protection was not yet settled; Saba happened to be eldest among younger sons and personally received the deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 雖身居重任，職當憂責，至於歲時稱慶，子孫在庭，顧視悲摧，心情斷絕，胡顏履戴，負媿神明。

translations.literal: Though body held heavy responsibility and office bore worry and blame, as to seasonal celebrations with descendants in the hall, looking back grief crushed, heart and feelings severed, shameful face treading Heaven and standing on earth, bearing guilt before the bright spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Though body held heavy responsibility and office bore worry and blame, as to seasonal celebrations with descendants in the hall, looking back grief crushed, heart and feelings severed, shameful face treading Heaven and standing on earth, bearing guilt before the bright spirits.

sentences.zh: 霈然之恩，旣以霑洽，愛敬之至，施及傍人。

translations.literal: Sudden rain-like grace already has soaked through; utmost love and reverence extend even to those beside.
translations.idiomatic: Sudden rain-like grace already has soaked through; utmost love and reverence extend even to those beside.

sentences.zh: 草木有心，禽魚感澤，況在人倫，而不銘戴。

translations.literal: Plants and trees have hearts; birds and fish feel the marsh; how much more in human relations—not to inscribe and bear on the head?
translations.idiomatic: Plants and trees have hearts; birds and fish feel the marsh; how much more in human relations—not to inscribe and bear on the head?

sentences.zh: 有家有國，信義為本，伏度來期，已應有日。

translations.literal: Having family and having state, faith and righteousness are the root; humbly calculating the coming date, already there should be a day.
translations.idiomatic: Having family and having state, faith and righteousness are the root; humbly calculating the coming date, already there should be a day.

sentences.zh: 一得奉見慈顏，永畢生願。

translations.literal: Once obtaining to serve and see your compassionate countenance, forever completing life's wish.
translations.idiomatic: Once obtaining to serve and see your compassionate countenance, forever completing life's wish.

sentences.zh: 生死肉骨，豈過今恩，負山戴岳，未足勝荷。

translations.literal: Death and life flesh and bone—how could it surpass today's grace; bearing mountains and wearing peaks—not enough to overcome bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Death and life flesh and bone—how could it surpass today's grace; bearing mountains and wearing peaks—not enough to overcome bearing.

sentences.zh: 二國分隔，理無書信，主上以彼朝不絕子母之恩，亦賜許奉答。

translations.literal: The two states are separated; by principle there are no letters; the sovereign because that court did not cut off mother-son affection also granted permission to send reply.
translations.idiomatic: The two states are separated; by principle there are no letters; the sovereign because that court did not cut off mother-son affection also granted permission to send reply.

sentences.zh: 不期今日，得通家問，伏紙嗚咽，言不宣心。

translations.literal: I did not expect today to obtain communication of family news; humbly before the paper I sob and choke; words cannot express the heart.
translations.idiomatic: I did not expect today to obtain communication of family news; humbly before the paper I sob and choke; words cannot express the heart.

sentences.zh: 蒙寄薩保別時所留錦袍表，年歲雖久，宛然猶識，抱此悲泣。

translations.literal: Receiving the brocade robe and collar you left when Sabao parted, though years have passed I still recognize them clearly, and holding them I weep in grief.
translations.idiomatic: You also sent the brocade robe and collar you had left when Sabao parted; though many years have passed, I still recognize them at once, and holding them I weep in grief.

sentences.zh: 至于拜見，事歸忍死，知復何心！

translations.literal: As for bowing and meeting face to face, the matter comes down to enduring life—what heart can I have left!
translations.idiomatic: As for bowing and meeting you in person, I must simply endure and live on—what heart can I have after that!

sentences.zh: 齊朝不卽發遣，更令與護書，要護重報，往返再三，而母竟不至。

translations.literal: The Qi court did not send her off at once, but had her exchange letters with Hu, requiring Hu to reply again; back and forth several times, yet his mother still did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi did not send her off at once, but had her exchange letters with Yuwen Hu, demanding repeated replies from him; after several rounds of correspondence, his mother still did not arrive.

sentences.zh: 朝議以其失信，令有司移齊曰：

translations.literal: The court, holding that they had broken faith, ordered the offices to address Qi, saying:
translations.idiomatic: The court, judging them faithless, ordered the offices to send a letter to Qi, saying:

sentences.zh: 夫有義則存，無信不立，山岳猶輕，兵食非重。

translations.literal: Where there is righteousness, there is survival; without trust nothing stands—mountains and rivers are still light, arms and grain are not heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Where there is righteousness a state survives; without good faith nothing endures—mountains and rivers may be slighted, but arms and provisions are not.

sentences.zh: 故言誓弗違，重耳所以享國；

translations.literal: Therefore oaths unbroken—Chong'er thereby held the state;
translations.idiomatic: Thus when pledges are kept unbroken, Chong'er was able to hold his state;

sentences.zh: 祝史無媿，隨會所以為盟。

translations.literal: the prayer-official without shame—Sui Hui thereby made the covenant.
translations.idiomatic: when the prayer-official had no shame to bear, Sui Hui was fit to bind the covenant.

sentences.zh: 未有司牧生民，君臨有國，可以忘義而多食言者也。

translations.literal: Never has one who shepherds the people and faces the realm as sovereign been able to forget righteousness and speak lightly many times.
translations.idiomatic: Never yet has a ruler who shepherds the people and faces the realm been able to forget righteousness and break his word again and again.

sentences.zh: 自數屬屯夷，時鐘圮隔，皇家親戚，淪陷三紀。

translations.literal: Since repeated years of turmoil, the times have struck ruin and separation; imperial kin have fallen captive for three reign-periods.
translations.idiomatic: Since years of repeated turmoil the age has struck ruin and separation, and imperial kin have lain captive for three reign-periods.

sentences.zh: 仁姑、世母，望絕生還。

translations.literal: Benevolent aunt and stepmother—hope of return alive was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: The benevolent aunt and stepmother were given up for lost, with no hope of return alive.

sentences.zh: 彼朝以去夏之初，德音爰發，已送仁姑，許歸世母。

translations.literal: That court, at the beginning of last summer, sent forth a gracious message, already sending the benevolent aunt and promising the stepmother's return.
translations.idiomatic: That court, at the beginning of last summer, issued a gracious message, had already sent the benevolent aunt, and promised the stepmother's return.

sentences.zh: 乃稱煩暑，指剋來秋。

translations.literal: Then they cited the oppressive heat and fixed the deadline at the coming autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Then they cited the oppressive heat and set the deadline for the coming autumn.

sentences.zh: 謂其信必由衷，嘉言無爽。

translations.literal: One took their sincerity as surely from the heart, their fine words as without breach.
translations.idiomatic: We took their sincerity as from the heart and their fine words as without breach.

sentences.zh: 今落木戒候，冰霜行及，方為世母虛設詭詞，未議言歸，更徵酬答。

translations.literal: Now fallen leaves warn of the season, frost and ice are near, yet for the stepmother they set empty deceitful words, did not discuss return, and again sought replies.
translations.idiomatic: Now fallen leaves warn of the season and frost and ice draw near, yet for the stepmother they offer empty deceit, will not discuss her return, and again demand replies.

sentences.zh: 子女玉帛，旣非所須，保境寧民，又云匪報。

translations.literal: Sons and daughters, jade and silk—were not what was needed; securing the borders and settling the people—they also said was no return.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and daughters, jade and silk were not what we sought; securing the borders and settling the people they also declared was no recompense.

sentences.zh: 詳觀此意，全乖本圖。

translations.literal: Examining this intent closely, it wholly departs from the original plan.
translations.idiomatic: Examined closely, this intent wholly departs from the original understanding.

sentences.zh: 愛人以禮，豈為姑息。

translations.literal: To love people by ritual—how could that be indulgence.
translations.idiomatic: To love people by ritual—how could that mean indulgence?

sentences.zh: 要子責誠，質親求報，實傷和氣，有悖天經。

translations.literal: To demand sincerity from a son, to pledge kin and seek return—this truly wounds harmony and violates heaven's constant.
translations.idiomatic: To demand sincerity from a son, to pledge kin and seek recompense—this truly wounds harmony and violates heaven's constant.

sentences.zh: 我之周室，太祖之天下也，焉可捐國顧家，殉名虧實！

translations.literal: Our Zhou house is Grand Progenitor's realm—how could one abandon the state for family, sacrifice the name and lose the substance!
translations.idiomatic: Our Zhou house is Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai's realm—how could one abandon the state for family, sacrifice reputation and lose substance!

sentences.zh: 不害所養，斯曰仁人。

translations.literal: Not harming what one nourishes—this is called a humane man.
translations.idiomatic: Not harming what one nourishes—this is called a humane man.

sentences.zh: 臥鼓潛鋒，孰非深計。

translations.literal: Drums laid aside, blades hidden—who does not use deep planning.
translations.idiomatic: Drums laid aside and blades hidden—who does not employ deep planning?

sentences.zh: 若令迭爭尺寸，兩競錐刀，瓦震長平，則趙分為二；

translations.literal: If one lets each side contend over inches, both compete for awl and knife, tiles shake at Changping—then Zhao is split in two;
translations.idiomatic: If each side contends over inches and both compete for awl and knife, tiles shake at Changping—then Zhao is split in two;

sentences.zh: 兵出函谷，則韓裂為三。

translations.literal: troops issue from Hangu Pass—then Han is split in three.
translations.idiomatic: troops issue from Hangu Pass—then Han is split in three.

sentences.zh: 安得猶全，謂無損益。

translations.literal: How could either remain whole and say there is no gain or loss.
translations.idiomatic: How could either remain whole and say there is no gain or loss?

sentences.zh: 大冢宰位隆將相，情兼家國，銜悲茹血，分畢冤魂，豈意噬指可尋，倚門應至。

translations.literal: The chief minister's rank towers over general and minister, his feeling embraces family and state; he swallows grief and blood, sharing the completion of wronged souls—who would think that biting finger could be traced, that leaning on the gate should have brought her.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister's rank towers over general and minister, his feeling embraces family and state; he swallows grief and blood, sharing the completion of wronged souls—who would think that biting finger could be traced, that leaning on the gate should have brought her?

sentences.zh: 徒聞善始，卒無令終，百辟震驚，三軍憤惋。

translations.literal: One hears only a good beginning, yet in the end no fine conclusion; the hundred ministers are shaken, the three armies indignant and grieved.
translations.idiomatic: One hears only of a good beginning, yet in the end no fine conclusion; the hundred ministers are shaken, the three armies indignant and grieved.

sentences.zh: 不為孝子，當作忠臣。

translations.literal: If not a filial son, then be a loyal minister.
translations.idiomatic: If one cannot be a filial son, then be a loyal minister.

sentences.zh: 去歲北軍深入，數俘城下。

translations.literal: Last year the northern army penetrated deep and took several cities below their walls.
translations.idiomatic: Last year the northern army penetrated deep and took several cities below their walls.

sentences.zh: 雖曰班師，餘功未遂。

translations.literal: Though they said they withdrew, remaining merit was not achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Though they said they withdrew, remaining objectives were not achieved.

sentences.zh: 今茲馬首南向，更期重入。

translations.literal: This year the horse's head turns south, and re-entry is again expected.
translations.idiomatic: This year the horse's head turns south, and a renewed advance is again expected.

sentences.zh: 晉人角之，我之職矣。

translations.literal: The Jin people corner them—this is our duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin people corner them—this is our duty.

sentences.zh: 聞諸道路，早已戒嚴，非直北拒，又將南略。

translations.literal: Hearing on the roads, they have long since been on alert—not only resisting the north, but also planning a southern thrust.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing on the roads, they have long since been on alert—not only resisting the north, but also planning a southern thrust.

sentences.zh: 儻欲自送，此之願也。

translations.literal: If they wish to deliver her themselves, that is our wish.
translations.idiomatic: If they wish to deliver her themselves, that is our wish.

sentences.zh: 如或嬰城，未能求敵，詰朝請見，與君周旋。

translations.literal: If instead they hold the walls and cannot seek the enemy, tomorrow morning we ask to meet and contend with you.
translations.idiomatic: If instead they hold the walls and will not meet us in the field, tomorrow morning we ask to meet and contend with you.

sentences.zh: 為惠不終，祇增深怨。

translations.literal: Favor not carried through—this only adds deep resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Favor not carried through—this only adds deep resentment.

sentences.zh: 愛親無慢，垂訓尼父；

translations.literal: Love kin without neglect—the Master's teaching;
translations.idiomatic: Love kin without neglect—this was the Master's teaching;

sentences.zh: 矜恤窮老，貽則周文。

translations.literal: Pity and succor the aged and poor—King Wen's model.
translations.idiomatic: pity and succor the aged and poor—King Wen's model.

sentences.zh: 環玦之義，事不由此，自應內省，豈宜有間。

translations.literal: The meaning of ring and tablet—this matter does not proceed from that; one should examine oneself within, how could there be breach.
translations.idiomatic: The meaning of ring and tablet—this matter does not proceed from that; one should examine oneself within; how could there be breach?

sentences.zh: 移書未送而母至。

translations.literal: The letter had not yet been sent when the mother arrived.
translations.idiomatic: The letter had not yet been sent when his mother arrived.

sentences.zh: 舉朝慶悅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: The whole court rejoiced, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The whole court rejoiced, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 護與母睽隔多年，一旦聚集，凡所資奉，窮極華盛。

translations.literal: Hu and his mother had been separated many years; once gathered, all that was supplied and served reached the utmost splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu and his mother had been separated many years; once reunited, all that was supplied and served reached the utmost splendor.

sentences.zh: 每四時伏臘，高祖率諸親戚，行家人之禮，稱觴上壽。

translations.literal: At each season's fasting day and year-end sacrifice, High Ancestor led the kinsmen in family rites, raising cups and offering long life.
translations.idiomatic: At each season's fasting day and year-end sacrifice, High Ancestor Yuwen Yong led the kinsmen in family rites, raising cups and offering long life.

sentences.zh: 榮貴之極，振古未聞。

translations.literal: Glory and honor at the extreme—unheard of since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Glory and honor at the extreme—unheard of since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 是年也，突厥復率衆赴期。

translations.literal: That year too, the Turks again led their masses to keep the rendezvous.
translations.idiomatic: That year too, the Turks again led their masses to keep the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 護以齊氏初送國親，未欲卽事征討，復慮失信蕃夷，更生邊患。

translations.literal: Hu, because Qi had just sent imperial kin, did not wish at once to undertake punitive action, yet also feared losing faith with the frontier tribes and renewing border trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu, because Northern Qi had just sent imperial kin, did not wish at once to undertake punitive action, yet also feared losing faith with the frontier tribes and renewing border trouble.

sentences.zh: 不得已，遂請東征。

translations.literal: Having no choice, he then requested an eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Having no choice, he then requested an eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔曰：「神若軒皇，尚雲三戰；

translations.literal: Ninth month, an edict said: "If even the divine Xuanyuan still spoke of three battles;
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, an edict said: "If even the divine Xuanyuan still spoke of three battles;

sentences.zh: 聖如姬武，且曰一戎。

translations.literal: if even the sage King Wu of Zhou said one campaign suffices.
translations.idiomatic: if even the sage King Wu of Zhou said one campaign suffices.

sentences.zh: 弧矢之威，干戈之用，帝王大器，誰能去兵。

translations.literal: The power of bow and arrow, the use of shield and spear—the great vessel of emperors and kings, who can dispense with arms.
translations.idiomatic: The power of bow and arrow, the use of shield and spear—the great vessel of emperors and kings, who can dispense with arms?

sentences.zh: 太祖丕受天明，造我周室，日月所照，罔不率從。

translations.literal: Grand Progenitor grandly received heaven's clarity and made our Zhou house; wherever sun and moon shine, none fail to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai grandly received heaven's mandate and made our Zhou house; wherever sun and moon shine, none fail to follow.

sentences.zh: 高氏乘釁跋扈，竊有並、冀，世濟其惡，腥穢彰聞。

translations.literal: The Gao house seized the opportunity and acted insolently, usurping Bing and Ji; generation after generation they piled up evil, their stench and filth openly known.
translations.idiomatic: The Gao house seized the opportunity and acted insolently, usurping Bing and Ji; generation after generation they piled up evil, their stench and filth openly known.

sentences.zh: 皇天震怒，假手突厥，驅略汾晉，掃地無遺。

translations.literal: August Heaven was enraged and lent its hand to the Turks; they drove through Fen and Jin and swept the ground clean, leaving nothing.
translations.idiomatic: August Heaven was enraged and lent its hand to the Turks; they drove through Fen and Jin and swept the ground clean, leaving nothing.

sentences.zh: 季孟勢窮，伯珪日蹙，坐待滅亡，鑒之愚智。

translations.literal: Ji Meng's power exhausted, Bo Gui daily pressed—sitting and awaiting extinction, a mirror to fool and sage.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Meng's power was exhausted, Bo Gui daily pressed—in sitting and awaiting extinction, fool and sage alike may read the lesson.

sentences.zh: 故突厥班師，仍屯彼境，更集諸部，傾國齊至，星流電擊，數道俱進，期在仲冬，同會幷、鄴。

translations.literal: Therefore the Turks withdrew their army yet still encamped in that territory, gathering the tribes again; the whole state of Qi came, star-stream and lightning-strike, several routes advancing together, the rendezvous set for mid-winter, jointly meeting at Bing and Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Turks withdrew their army yet still encamped in that territory, gathering the tribes again; the whole state of Qi came like star-stream and lightning-strike, several routes advancing together, the rendezvous set for mid-winter, jointly meeting at Bing and Ye.

sentences.zh: 大冢宰晉公，朕之懿昆，任隆伊、呂，平一宇宙，惟公是屬。

translations.literal: The chief minister, Duke of Jin, our fine elder brother—his charge towers like Yi Yin and Lü Shang; to pacify the universe, only the duke is fit.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, our fine elder brother—his charge towers like Yi Yin and Lü Shang; to pacify the universe, only the duke is fit.

sentences.zh: 朕當親執斧鉞，廟庭祗受。

translations.literal: We shall personally take up axe and halberd and reverently receive them in the temple court.
translations.idiomatic: We shall personally take up axe and halberd and reverently receive them in the temple court.

sentences.zh: 有司宜勒衆軍，量程赴集。

translations.literal: The offices should muster the armies and measure the march to assemble.
translations.idiomatic: The offices should muster the armies and measure the march to assemble.

sentences.zh: 進止遲速，委公處分。

translations.literal: Advance and halt, speed and delay—entrusted to the duke's disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Advance and halt, speed and delay—entrusted to the duke's disposition.

sentences.zh: 」於是征二十四軍及左右廂散隸、及秦隴巴蜀之兵、諸蕃國之衆二十萬人。

translations.literal: " Thereupon twenty-four armies were mobilized, together with the left and right wing scattered retainers, troops from Qin, Long, Ba, and Shu, and masses from the various frontier states—two hundred thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon twenty-four armies were mobilized, together with the left and right wing scattered retainers, troops from Qin, Long, Ba, and Shu, and masses from the various frontier states—two hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 十月，帝於廟庭授護斧鉞。

translations.literal: Tenth month, the Emperor in the temple court invested Hu with axe and halberd.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, the emperor in the temple court invested Yuwen Hu with axe and halberd.

sentences.zh: 出軍至潼關，乃遣柱國尉遲迥率精兵十萬為前鋒，大將軍權景宣率山南之兵出豫州，少師楊摽出軹關。

translations.literal: The army issued forth to Tong Pass; then Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong was sent to lead one hundred thousand picked troops as vanguard; Grand General Quan Jingxuan led the armies south of the mountains out through Yu Province; Junior Preceptor Yang Biao out through Zhi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The army issued forth to Tong Pass; then Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong was sent to lead one hundred thousand picked troops as vanguard; Grand General Quan Jingxuan led the armies south of the mountains out through Yu Province; Junior Preceptor Yang Biao out through Zhi Pass.

sentences.zh: 護連營漸進，屯軍弘農。

translations.literal: Hu advanced camp by camp and halted the army at Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu advanced camp by camp and halted the army at Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 迥攻圍洛陽。

translations.literal: Jiong attacked and besieged Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchi Jiong attacked and besieged Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 柱國齊公憲、鄭國公達奚武等營於邙山。

translations.literal: Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, Duke of Zheng Daxi Wu, and others encamped on Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Duke of Qi, Daxi Wu, Duke of Zheng, and others encamped on Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 護性無戎略，且此行也，又非其本心。

translations.literal: Hu by nature lacked military strategy, and moreover this campaign was not from his own heart.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu by nature lacked military strategy, and moreover this campaign was not from his own heart.

sentences.zh: 故師出雖久，無所克獲。

translations.literal: Therefore though the army was out long, nothing was taken or gained.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore though the army was out long, nothing was taken or gained.

sentences.zh: 護本令塹斷河陽之路，遏其救兵，然後同攻洛陽，使其內外隔絕。

translations.literal: Hu had originally ordered trenches cut to block the Heyang road, check their relief troops, and then jointly attack Luoyang, isolating it within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu had originally ordered trenches cut to block the Heyang road, check their relief troops, and then jointly attack Luoyang, isolating it within and without.

sentences.zh: 諸將以為齊兵必不敢出，唯斥候而已。

translations.literal: The generals thought Qi troops would surely not dare come out, and only sent scouts.
